endpoints.name: sqlite3_prepare
sqlite3_create_function_v2
endpoints.template:
gf_rand::seed($__seed);
if ($db == nullptr) { gf_bail(); }

const char* funcName = gf_rand::get_string(5).c_str(); // Generating a random function name
int nArg = gf_rand::get<int>() % 5; // Random number of arguments, say between 0-4
int eTextRep = -1; // Use -1 for default text representation

// Call the sqlite3_create_function_v2 function
int rc = sqlite3_create_function_v2(
    $db, 
    funcName, 
    nArg, 
    eTextRep, 
    0,            // application data, can be NULL in this case
    0,            // xFunc, no function pointer provided
    0,            // xStep, no step function provided
    0,            // xFinal, no final step function provided
    0             // xDestroy, no destroy function provided
);

if (rc != SQLITE_OK) { gf_bail(); } // Error handling based on return code

gf_rand::seed($__seed);
size_t random_size = gf_rand::get<size_t>(); // Get a random size value 
void *p = sqlite3_malloc64(random_size); // Allocate memory with the random size

if (p == nullptr) { gf_bail(); } // Validate the allocation 

size_t size = sqlite3_msize(p); // Call sqlite3_msize with the pointer 
if (size == 0) { gf_bail(); } // Ensure size is valid

sqlite3_free(p); // Clean up the allocated memory
